faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.stillNotSureBody: Ask the SickBot — our assistant answers shipping, fitment and converter questions in seconds.

items.q: What types of products does SickMotos offer?
items.a: Performance parts for Supermoto and Enduro: titanium exhausts, LED headlights, ECU tuning modules, carbon parts, titanium screws, racing brake discs, supermoto rim sets, graphics kits and merchandise.
Yes. SickMotos ships worldwide. We deliver across Europe, the Middle East, North America and Asia. Most orders arrive within 5 to 10 business days.

items.q: Do SickMotos products come with a warranty?
items.a: All products carry a manufacturer's warranty of up to 6 months against defects in materials or workmanship. Optional 1-year extended warranty available at €49.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, American Express, Apple Pay and Bitcoin. All transactions are encrypted and secure.

items.q: Can I get a custom performance setup for my motorbike?
items.a: Yes. Ask the SickBot (the chat button, bottom-right) or use the contact form with your bike details and goals, and we'll put together a tailored package.
